key_decisions.decision: Retain the age threshold and exact total before the later change to twenty.
Preserve the first-person quotation embedded in the roster.
Follow Shelomith’s read form and retain the relationship to Ladan despite the repeated Shimei name.
Retain Zizah’s differing form and the reason for combining two families.
Choose the sacred-things reading while noting the alternative consecration of Aaron himself.
Retain the daughters and render brothers as the kinship relationship established by the genealogy.
Keep the lowered age threshold and individual registration.
Keep each food preparation category and the measuring responsibility, with the uncertain mixed offering noted.
